## Two-Space High Pincer
In modern pro games, pincers like this don't show up that much because AI says that you don't get a good result. From that standpoint, you might say that you shouldn't pincer without a good reason. But this pincer can also lead to a lot of unfamiliar variations. If you know about them, you may get an advantage. (See [AI Masterclass](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-TQy9F8lnhc&t=75s); see also [AGA Master Review Series, Game 35: [W] Master vs. Jiang Weijie 9p [B]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1vVe1pKmhQ4&t=326).)

[Explanation by Go Pro Yeonwoo on Youtube (SDK/Dan)](https://youtu.be/w5CyNBt_Uso?si=9uZ39ctwyfeV4Y9w)
